verses.original: וַיְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ וְזִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר שָׁמֹר֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw mō·šeh wə·ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- hā·‘ām lê·mōr šā·mōr ’eṯ- kāl- ham·miṣ·wāh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ·ḵem hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Then Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people . . . Keep all the commandments I am giving you today
verses.literalPt: Ordenou Moisés e os anciãos de Israel ao povo, dizendo: Guarda todo o mandamento que eu hoje te ordeno.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בַּיּוֹם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעַבְר֣וּ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֑ךְ וַהֲקֵמֹתָ֤ לְךָ֙ אֲבָנִ֣ים גְּדֹל֔וֹת וְשַׂדְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּשִּֽׂיד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ’ă·šer ta·‘aḇ·rū ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lāḵ wa·hă·qê·mō·ṯā lə·ḵā ’ă·ḇā·nîm gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ wə·śaḏ·tā ’ō·ṯām baś·śîḏ
verses.literal: And on the day you cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD your God is giving you set up large stones and coat them with plaster
verses.literalPt: No dia em que passares o Jordão para a terra que Jeová, teu Deus, te está dando, levantar-te-ás grandes pedras e as caiarás.

verses.original: וְכָתַבְתָּ֣ עֲלֵיהֶ֗ן אֶֽת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֛י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בְּעָבְרֶ֑ךָ לְמַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ תָּבֹ֨א אֶל־ הָאָ֜רֶץ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֣יךָ׀ נֹתֵ֣ן לְךָ֗ אֶ֣רֶץ זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·ṯaḇ·tā ‘ă·lê·hen ’eṯ- kāl- diḇ·rê hat·tō·w·rāh haz·zōṯ bə·‘ā·ḇə·re·ḵā lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šer tā·ḇō ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ăšer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇaš ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā lāḵ
verses.literal: Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over to enter . . . the land that the LORD your God is giving you a land flowing with milk and honey just as the LORD the God of your fathers has promised you
verses.literalPt: Nelas, escreverás todas as palavras desta lei, quando tiveres passado; para que entres na terra que Jeová, teu Deus, te está dando, terra que mana leite e mel, assim como Jeová, Deus de teus pais, te prometeu.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֮ בְּעָבְרְכֶ֣ם אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ תָּקִ֜ימוּ אֶת־ הָאֲבָנִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֛ם הַיּ֖וֹם בְּהַ֣ר עֵיבָ֑ל וְשַׂדְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֖ם בַּשִּֽׂיד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·‘ā·ḇə·rə·ḵem ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên tā·qî·mū ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ·ḵem hay·yō·wm bə·har ‘ê·ḇāl wə·śaḏ·tā ’ō·w·ṯām baś·śîḏ
verses.literal: And when you have crossed the Jordan you are to set up these stones on Mount Ebal as I am commanding you today - and you are to coat them with plaster
verses.literalPt: Quando tiverdes passado o Jordão, levantareis estas pedras, que eu hoje vos ordeno, no monte Ebal, e as caiareis.

verses.original: וּבָנִ֤יתָ שָּׁם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ מִזְבַּ֣ח אֲבָנִ֔ים לֹא־ תָנִ֥יף עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם בַּרְזֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·nî·ṯā šām miz·bê·aḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā miz·baḥ ’ă·ḇā·nîm lō- ṯā·nîp̄ ‘ă·lê·hem bar·zel
verses.literal: Moreover, you are to build there an altar to the LORD your God an altar of stones You must not use any iron tool on them
verses.literalPt: Edificarás ali um altar a Jeová, teu Deus, um altar de pedras; não alçaras sobre elas instrumento de ferro.

verses.original: אֲבָנִ֤ים שְׁלֵמוֹת֙ תִּבְנֶ֔ה אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְהַעֲלִ֤יתָ עָלָיו֙ עוֹלֹ֔ת לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇā·nîm šə·lê·mō·wṯ tiḇ·neh ’eṯ- miz·baḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·ha·‘ă·lî·ṯā ‘ā·lāw ‘ō·w·lōṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: You shall build the altar of the LORD your God with uncut stones and offer upon it burnt offerings to the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: De pedras brutas edificarás o altar de Jeová, teu Deus; e oferecerás sobre ele holocaustos a Jeová, teu Deus.

verses.original: וְזָבַחְתָּ֥ שְׁלָמִ֖ים וְאָכַ֣לְתָּ שָּׁ֑ם וְשָׂ֣מַחְתָּ֔ לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḇaḥ·tā šə·lā·mîm wə·’ā·ḵal·tā šām wə·śā·maḥ·tā lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: There you are to sacrifice your peace offerings eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Sacrificarás ofertas pacíficas e comerás ali; te alegrarás diante de Jeová, teu Deus.

verses.original: וְכָתַבְתָּ֣ עַל־ הָאֲבָנִ֗ים אֶֽת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֛י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בַּאֵ֥ר הֵיטֵֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·ṯaḇ·tā ‘al- hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm ’eṯ- kāl- diḇ·rê hat·tō·w·rāh haz·zōṯ ba·’êr hê·ṭêḇ
verses.literal: And you shall write distinctly . . . upon these stones all the words of this law
verses.literalPt: Escreverás mui distintamente nestas pedras todas as palavras desta lei.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶ֥ל כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הַסְכֵּ֤ת׀ וּשְׁמַע֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ נִהְיֵ֣יתָֽ לְעָ֔ם לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm hal·wî·yim ’el kāl- yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr has·kêṯ ū·šə·ma‘ yiś·rā·’êl hay·yō·wm haz·zeh nih·yê·ṯā lə·‘ām Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: Then Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel . . . Be silent O Israel and listen This day you have become the people of the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Disse Moisés e os levitas sacerdotes a todo o Israel: Guarda silêncio e ouve, ó Israel; hoje, vieste a ser o povo de Jeová, teu Deus.

verses.original: וְשָׁ֣מַעְתָּ֔ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֶת־ מִצְוֺתָו֙ וְאֶת־ חֻקָּ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ma‘·tā bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- miṣ·w·ṯå̄w wə·’eṯ- ḥuq·qāw ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: You shall therefore obey the voice of the LORD your God and follow His commandments and statutes I am giving you today . . .
verses.literalPt: Obedecerás à voz de Jeová, teu Deus, e cumprirás os seus mandamentos e os seus estatutos, que eu hoje vos ordeno.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw mō·šeh ’eṯ- hā·‘ām bay·yō·wm ha·hū lê·mōr
verses.literal: On that . . . day Moses commanded the people
verses.literalPt: No mesmo dia, ordenou Moisés ao povo, dizendo:

verses.original: אֵ֠לֶּה יַֽעַמְד֞וּ לְבָרֵ֤ךְ אֶת־ הָעָם֙ עַל־ הַ֣ר גְּרִזִ֔ים בְּעָבְרְכֶ֖ם אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן שִׁמְעוֹן֙ וְלֵוִ֣י וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר וְיוֹסֵ֥ף וּבִנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ya·‘am·ḏū lə·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām ‘al- har gə·ri·zîm bə·‘ā·ḇə·rə·ḵem ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên šim·‘ō·wn wə·lê·wî wî·hū·ḏāh wə·yiś·śā·š·ḵār wə·yō·w·sêp̄ ū·ḇin·yā·min
verses.literal: When you have crossed the Jordan these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people Simeon Levi Judah Issachar Joseph and Benjamin
verses.literalPt: Quando tiverdes passado o Jordão, estes estarão sobre o monte Gerizim, para abençoarem o povo: Simeão, Levi, Judá, Issacar, José e Benjamim;

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה יַֽעַמְד֥וּ עַל־ הַקְּלָלָ֖ה בְּהַ֣ר עֵיבָ֑ל רְאוּבֵן֙ גָּ֣ד וְאָשֵׁ֔ר וּזְבוּלֻ֖ן דָּ֥ן וְנַפְתָּלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh ya·‘am·ḏū ‘al- haq·qə·lā·lāh bə·har ‘ê·ḇāl rə·’ū·ḇên gāḏ wə·’ā·šêr ū·zə·ḇū·lun dān wə·nap̄·tā·lî
verses.literal: And these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal to deliver the curse Reuben Gad Asher Zebulun Dan and Naphtali
verses.literalPt: e estes estarão sobre o monte Ebal, para deitarem a maldição: Rúben, Gade, Aser, Zebulom, Dã e Naftali.

verses.original: וְעָנ֣וּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם וְאָֽמְר֛וּ אֶל־ כָּל־ אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ק֥וֹל רָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·nū hal·wî·yim wə·’ā·mə·rū ’el- kāl- ’îš yiś·rā·’êl qō·wl rām
verses.literal: Then the Levites shall proclaim in a loud voice to every Israelite . . .
verses.literalPt: Os levitas responderão e dirão a todos os homens de Israel em voz alta:

verses.original: אָר֣וּר הָאִ֡ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשֶׂה֩ פֶ֨סֶל וּמַסֵּכָ֜ה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה מַעֲשֵׂ֛ה יְדֵ֥י חָרָ֖שׁ וְשָׂ֣ם בַּסָּ֑תֶר וְעָנ֧וּ כָל־ הָעָ֛ם וְאָמְר֖וּ אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr hā·’îš ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śeh p̄e·sel ū·mas·sê·ḵāh tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê ḥā·rāš wə·śām bas·sā·ṯer wə·‘ā·nū ḵāl hā·‘ām wə·’ā·mə·rū ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is the man who makes a carved idol or molten image an abomination to the LORD the work of the hands of a craftsman and sets it up in secret And let all the people . . . say Amen
verses.literalPt: Maldito o homem que faz uma imagem esculpida ou fundida, coisa abominável a Jeová, obra da mão do artífice, e a põe em secreto! E todo o povo responderá: Amém!

verses.original: אָר֕וּר מַקְלֶ֥ה אָבִ֖יו וְאִמּ֑וֹ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr maq·leh ’ā·ḇîw wə·’im·mōw wə·’ā·mar kāl- hā·‘ām ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who dishonors his father or mother And let all the people say Amen
verses.literalPt: Maldito aquele que não honra a seu pai ou a sua mãe! E todo o povo dirá: Amém!

verses.original: אָר֕וּר מַסִּ֖יג גְּב֣וּל רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr mas·sîḡ gə·ḇūl rê·‘ê·hū wə·’ā·mar kāl- hā·‘ām ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who moves his neighbor’s boundary stone And let all the people say Amen
verses.literalPt: Maldito aquele que remove os marcos do seu próximo! E todo o povo dirá: Amém!

verses.original: אָר֕וּר מַשְׁגֶּ֥ה עִוֵּ֖ר בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr maš·geh ‘iw·wêr bad·dā·reḵ wə·’ā·mar kāl- hā·‘ām ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who lets a blind man wander in the road And let all the people say Amen
verses.literalPt: Maldito aquele que faz que o cego erre no caminho! E todo o povo dirá: Amém!

verses.original: אָר֗וּר מַטֶּ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט גֵּר־ יָת֖וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֑ה וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr maṭ·ṭeh miš·paṭ gêr- yā·ṯō·wm wə·’al·mā·nāh wə·’ā·mar kāl- hā·‘ām ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner the fatherless or the widow And let all the people say Amen
verses.literalPt: Maldito aquele que perverte o direito do peregrino, do órfão e da viúva! E todo o povo dirá: Amém!

verses.original: אָר֗וּר שֹׁכֵב֙ עִם־ אֵ֣שֶׁת אָבִ֔יו כִּ֥י גִלָּ֖ה כְּנַ֣ף אָבִ֑יו וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr šō·ḵêḇ ‘im- ’ê·šeṯ ’ā·ḇîw kî ḡil·lāh kə·nap̄ ’ā·ḇîw wə·’ā·mar kāl- hā·‘ām ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who sleeps with his father’s wife for he has violated his father’s marriage bed And let all the people say Amen
verses.literalPt: Maldito aquele que se deita com a mulher de seu pai, porque levantou o vestido de seu pai! E todo o povo dirá: Amém!

verses.original: אָר֕וּר שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם־ כָּל־ בְּהֵמָ֑ה וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr šō·ḵêḇ ‘im- kāl- bə·hê·māh wə·’ā·mar kāl- hā·‘ām ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who lies with any animal And let all the people say Amen
verses.literalPt: Maldito aquele que se deita com qualquer animal! E todo o povo dirá: Amém!

verses.original: אָר֗וּר שֹׁכֵב֙ עִם־ אֲחֹת֔וֹ בַּת־ אָבִ֖יו א֣וֹ בַת־ אִמּ֑וֹ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr šō·ḵêḇ ‘im- ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw baṯ- ’ā·ḇîw ’ōw ḇaṯ- ’im·mōw wə·’ā·mar kāl- hā·‘ām ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who sleeps with his sister the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother And let all the people say Amen
verses.literalPt: Maldito aquele que se deita com sua irmã, filha de seu pai ou filha de sua mãe! E todo o povo dirá: Amém!

verses.original: אָר֕וּר שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם־ חֹֽתַנְתּ֑וֹ וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr šō·ḵêḇ ‘im- ḥō·ṯan·tōw wə·’ā·mar kāl- hā·‘ām ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who sleeps with his mother-in-law And let all the people say Amen
verses.literalPt: Maldito aquele que se deita com sua sogra! E todo o povo dirá: Amém!

verses.original: אָר֕וּר מַכֵּ֥ה רֵעֵ֖הוּ בַּסָּ֑תֶר וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr mak·kêh rê·‘ê·hū bas·sā·ṯer wə·’ā·mar kāl- hā·‘ām ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who strikes down his neighbor in secret And let all the people say Amen
verses.literalPt: Maldito aquele que fere ao seu próximo em secreto! E todo o povo dirá: Amém!

verses.original: אָרוּר֙ לֹקֵ֣חַ שֹׁ֔חַד לְהַכּ֥וֹת נֶ֖פֶשׁ דָּ֣ם נָקִ֑י וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr lō·qê·aḥ šō·ḥaḏ lə·hak·kō·wṯ ne·p̄eš dām nā·qî wə·’ā·mar kāl- hā·‘ām ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person . . . And let all the people say Amen
verses.literalPt: Maldito aquele que recebe peita para matar uma pessoa inocente! E todo o povo dirá: Amém!

verses.original: אָר֗וּר אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־ יָקִ֛ים אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַתּוֹרָֽה־ הַזֹּ֖את לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אוֹתָ֑ם וְאָמַ֥ר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אָמֵֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr ’ă·šer lō- yā·qîm ’eṯ- diḇ·rê hat·tō·w·rāh- haz·zōṯ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’ō·w·ṯām wə·’ā·mar kāl- hā·‘ām ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who does not put the words of this law into practice And let all the people say Amen
verses.literalPt: Maldito aquele que não confirma as palavras desta lei, para as cumprir! E todo o povo dirá: Amém!
